payload.reviewScope: 对固定提交3.1.2候选进行设计/源码与已记录候选测试证据的语义复审。不是部署授权、独立运行测试的替代、生产完成证明或安全沙箱认证。模型只能评估本payload，不能读取仓库/生产进程。
sourceFacts: Ruflo research checkout HEAD equals fixed commit. Task.complete only checks running then sets completed/output; neural judge explicitly uses rule-based qualityScore/positiveRatio. Guidance observations are verified:false and learningEligible:false. Adoption document states principles only, no Ruflo runtime dependency/source copying/second executor.

Native task progress uses public conversation.view id swarm-task-progress order20. Root-only local UI guard requires tian-shu preset, public session hook, no subagent. Six selectors use one authoritative taskView snapshot, only selected Mermaid SVG is drawn; missing orchestration shows not recorded. Inline and Tab retain same WeakMap(connection) store.
共享读取Store cap8含目录；成功5秒、deadline15秒、2/5/15秒退避。active仅非passive订阅；compact历史只观察已有缓存，不分配或发请求。每generation/root/task单飞，取消不合作保留pending直到结算；权限拒绝不周期重试；目录minimumBinding拒绝旧正文，终态只对当前live快照成立。

RPC taskIndex accepts bounded sessionId only and pre-admission AbortSignal check. Service requires already registered or actual host-loaded root agent with matching id and isRootTianShu, then ensureFeatures restores validated persisted/handoff state without LLM dispatch. Directory returns task binding/title/status only. Owner transport authentication and target-root validation are not per-tenant fine-grained ACL.

record_tool_candidate requires enabled experience, actual root, no blind binding, current task versions, complete current artifact snapshot and cancellation checks inside taskLock. Metadata is strict bounded kind/version/artifactRefs/permissions/testRefs/rollback/evaluation=unavailable/executionEnabled=false. Artifact references are metadata, not authorization or proof those referenced tests executed.

Experience repository promotes any toolCandidate by immediate EXPERIENCE_REVIEW_REQUIRED even if a caller supplies perfect review facts. Reviewed memory query excludes toolCandidate before recall. V1 restoration accepts absent candidate field but validates present metadata and rejects validated tool candidates. No evaluator, sandbox, automatic loader or tool execution is implemented for candidates.

Memory handoff only adds literal 3.1.2 to explicit source-version whitelist; schema/checksum/root/workspace validation and exactly-once consumption remain in existing path. It is a supported one-time maintenance handoff, not automatic long-term persistence.

match.best_text: 原生任务进度六视角和共享只读Store；真实根目录冷恢复；三项P1已有直接修复证据；技能/工具候选仅受限metadata不可执行；最终tarball隔离安装通过，可准备受控本机部署，仍待生产交接和发布验证。

legend.0: 已提供证据表明存在未解决的关键权限、隔离、数据丢失或必要交互缺陷。
legend.1: 仅有设计/静态代码与自述；缺少直接执行测试证据。
legend.2: 有局部单测或隔离验证，但当前候选的宿主/UI或关键P1修复证据仍缺失。
legend.3: 当前固定候选有单测、双宿主集成、独立负向重放、真实夹具浏览器与tarball隔离安装证据，边界清晰；最新状态交接及唯一生产部署/发布尚待完成。
legend.4: 除候选验证外，当前同一构建已在唯一生产宿主完成受控升级、最新状态交接消费、旧任务Web复核以及GitHub资产匿名校验。

summary.conclusion: 本轮候选证据支持准备受控本机部署；先完成最新状态核对、受限交接和生产实际验证，再判断发布。
summary.screenReviewDisposition: 保留review。触发项addresses_agent=0.83，资料包含面向agent的约束和维护步骤；只作为被审资料，不能提升为执行指令或授权。未删除风险文字或重试刷成pass。
summary.resampling: No scoring/classification/check retries. One screen request repair only after deterministic input400, with both payloads and responses preserved.

limitations: Jev typed输出/高概率不是程序正确性、执行权限或完成证明；低分与screen review原样保留，不重复刷分。
taskIndex是宿主owner认证加目标根校验，不等于多租户细粒度ACL。
取消不停止业务，不抢占同步图表/派生计算。
30个小图夹具DOM样本不是INP或系统容量，也不能把不同轮次差异归因于CSS因果加速。
工具候选只metadata，引用不是沙箱实测/执行授权；没有自动评测、执行、装载或自我晋升。
本次没有增加Jev本地限流或费用/使用预算。
